meta.title: The Gold Reserve

meta.note: the opponent can win TWO ways next turn: buy L3-6 (after their setup card) OR take the last 2 white for a card in their hand. Take the 2 white first (kills that win + funds you), then reserve L3-6 (kills the other), then buy it.
